summary: Immune to Blinded and critical hits. Gain +2 to saves against spells and cast Immolating Gaze.

fields.Infernal Sight: See in ordinary darkness out to 40 ft and gain immunity to the Blinded status group. The pinned rule reports that it does not see through magical Darkness despite the tooltip.
fields.Immolating Gaze: Action once per Short Rest within 30 ft. The target makes an Intelligence save against your spell save DC. On a failure it takes 2d8 Fire and is Fearful for 3 turns. On a success it avoids Fearful and takes half of 2d8 Fire, or half of 4d8 Fire if already Burning. The pinned source reports that Burning changes damage only on a successful save.
fields.Base value: 570 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Fearful: Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks. The target must flee from the source of fear, cannot take additional actions or make opportunity attacks, and can save at the end of its turn if out of sight. Effects that modify saves against Frightened do not change the initial Immolating Gaze save.
